narrative.overview:
Blabbit's site is a light, cool, well-lit desk with Mac software on it. Cool paper is the room; white Mac windows sit on it under soft, long ambient shadows; ink carries every word and every action. The single thing that moves with intent is voice turning into text: words leave the dark recording pill and land at a cursor. Everything else holds still and stays out of the way, at the quiet of Things and the clarity of Wispr Flow.

The page proves itself by showing the product working rather than decorating it. Product scenes (a Notes window, keycaps, a text field, a Gatekeeper row, a Terminal line) are rendered in live HTML and CSS, never baked into images, so every word stays real text. The one dark object on the page is Blabbit's own overlay: the recording pill and the dotted listening orb. It explicitly refuses the dark, neon-glow AI landing page.

Density is generous and single-column at heart: a centered hero, then alternating two-column copy-and-figure rows on a 1120px container, separated by very large vertical rests (150px).
keyCharacteristics: Cool paper ground, white windows, ink text and ink actions.
Voice teal appears only where speech is live or just became text.
Wide-stretch Mona Sans headlines over a normal-width Mona Sans body.
Monaspace Neon only for keys, timers, code and measurements.
Soft, layered ambient shadows; no hard edges, no neon glow.
GSAP motion on expo.out with one orchestrated entrance and one signature loop; all of it skipped under reduced motion.

rules.name: The Live Speech Rule
rules.body: Voice teal marks speech that is happening or has just landed as text. It is never a button, a link, a heading color or a decorative accent. If nothing is being said, nothing is teal.

rules.name: The Ink Acts Rule
rules.body: Every call to action is ink on white text. Download buttons, step numbers and confirmations are ink; there is no second brand-colored button.

rules.name: The One Dark Object Rule
rules.body: Dark surfaces belong to Blabbit's own overlay (the pill and orb) and to the terminal line. Never darken a section, a card or the page to create drama.

rules.name: The Wide Headline Rule
rules.body: Only h1 and h2 go wide (120 to 122% stretch); titles, body and UI text stay at 100%. Stretch is how the page says "headline", not size alone.

rules.name: The Instrument Mono Rule
rules.body: Monaspace Neon is only for keys, timers, code and measurements. Never set a heading, label, button or paragraph in mono.

rules.name: The Ambient Only Rule
rules.body: Shadows are soft, blurred and negatively spread so they fall below the object. No hard offset shadows, no colored glows (the float-word's faint teal underglow is the single speech-tinted exception).

dos: **Do** use ink for every action and voice teal (#0b8f9c) only for live speech: carets, spoken-word chips, held keys, the "you speak" bar, the orb.
**Do** set h1 and h2 in Mona Sans at 120 to 122% width with negative tracking (-0.025 to -0.03em), and everything else at 100%.
**Do** show the product working inside HTML Mac chrome (windows, keycaps, fields, pills) with real text, not screenshots of text.
**Do** lift white surfaces with the soft ink-tinted ambient shadows plus a 1px low-alpha ink ring, never a drawn border.
**Do** animate on expo.out, keep one orchestrated entrance per page, and give every GSAP sequence a static reduced-motion state.
**Do** keep all fonts and scripts self-hosted; the page makes no third-party requests.
donts: **Don't** use voice teal for buttons, links, headings, icons or decoration.
**Don't** set headings, labels, buttons or prose in Monaspace Neon; mono is for keys, timers, code and measurements.
**Don't** darken sections or cards for drama, or add neon glows and gradient washes; the dark objects are Blabbit's overlay pill, orb panel and the terminal line.
**Don't** use hard offset shadows or square corners on surfaces.
**Don't** add a second accent; link blue stays on links and focus, ink stays on actions.
